name: Advanced process control and real-time optimisation
principle: Model-predictive controllers push units against constraints automatically, and real-time optimisation updates targets from plant models. Yokogawa's APC at Shell Deer Park's gas oil hydrotreater (2013) maximises ULSD output, controls reactor temperature and balances fractionator heater passes.

performance.metric: payback time of the Deer Park GOHT APC
performance.basis: Yokogawa reference; project 8% under budget; benefit 198% greater than the original estimate

source.note: Yokogawa, Shell Deer Park refinery APC on gas oil hydrotreater (completed 2013)

advantages: Quick payback in the reference case
Less operator intervention and sulfur giveaway
limitations: The reference gives no absolute dollar benefit
